title: I've vibecoded a Windows XP simulator with Matrix-themed riddle game. Can you beat it in less than 7 minutes?
author: sabelnick
selftext:
I have vibecoded a game! The narrative goes like this:

"You're Neo, trying to hack into Epstein Files, 1998, in Matrix. Can you do it?"

* Windows XP simulator, such nostalgia! Winamp, Minesweeper, ICQ...
* Matrix-themed stuff
* Hacking
* Social engineering
* Satirical ending that's according to my friends "a little too much"

I'm curious if anyone of you can finish it in less than 7 minutes 😆

[https://amateurminal.com/](https://amateurminal.com/)

If you can complete it, post here your time (you'll be in the in-game leaderboard too).

The story behind it: My colleagues were helping me to setup dev environment... I'm amateur in Terminal... amateur... terminal... amateurminal.... amateurminal.com... lol, domain wasn't taken 😂 I had to buy that domain.

I built this as a joke—a terminal where every command succeeds. Then it turned into a full game.

If you’re tech-savvy and curious, you can finish it. If you can't, well 😂

comments.author: FUCKUWO
comments.body: can you make a video showing how you made it

replies.author: sabelnick
replies.body:
Just open Figma Make and tell it to create Windows XP desktop with. Then add apps one by one. You can find projects on github that recreated many of the original apps as website (search for terms like  "Webamp" or "Minesweeper GitHub"), then just copy the link to the Figma Make chat and ask it to put it there.

Small steps.

replies.author: sabelnick
replies.body: Btw not just Figma Make, I guess it would work the same in Loveable, [Bolt.new](http://Bolt.new) or other similar AI builders, they all do the same thing
